## Exactly, at most, more than {#l2-events }

```{=html}
<div data-module="subset" ></div>
```



::: {.takeaway}
Build the event first. Then add its frequencies.
:::

::: notes
This uses the pets dataset. Exactly 2 ->10/50=.20; at most 2 ->45/50=.90; more than 2 ->5/50=.10. The complementary events ≤2 and >2 sum to 1.
:::
